notes: Added FEHA_MELEE_CATALOG.js v1.0.0 covering all 33 weapons in the MELEE folder.
Melee is balanced around one Action = one strike so Sandevistan extra Actions scale the style instead of forcing gun-level damage onto every swing.
Gorilla Arms satisfy all melee STR requirements; heavy melee uses higher STR gates while knives/light weapons usually have none.
Most melee weapons intentionally have no bespoke passive: damage, STR, reach, and thrown stats carry their identity.
Chainsword Legendary gets REDLINE // TEETH IN THE WOUND: once per turn, a second same-turn hit on the same target adds 3d10 and ignores worn-armor weapon damage reduction for that hit.
Errata gets THERMAL RUNAWAY: consecutive same-turn hits on one target escalate from normal to +2d8 fire, then +4d8 fire with worn-armor reduction ignored from the third hit onward.
Neurotoxin Knife gets BLACKOUT DOSE: failed CON save poisons and removes reactions; a repeat failed dose while poisoned crashes the nervous system into Stunned.
Dildo Stout is intentionally just 1d100 bludgeoning damage with no extra passive.
ADK DEV LOADER now preflights, contract-checks, migrates, and hot-rerenders the melee catalog.
